readme.introduction: [MongoDB](https://github.com/mongodb/mongo) (created by [mongodb](https://github.com/mongodb/)) the popular, open-source NoSQL document-oriented database designed for handling large volumes of unstructured or semi-structured data. Unlike traditional relational databases (RDBMS) that use tables, MongoDB stores data in flexible, JSON-like BSON documents (Binary JSON). It is highly scalable, supports rapid development, and is widely used for modern web and mobile applications.
